scope: G09 visible tab and field insertion/selection context in the existing local designer
cause: Canvas-local tab cache diverged from inspector and insertion context; entering a nested subform cleared the shared tab and moving between tabs used the same child array.
changes: Deleted the canvas tab cache and redundant active-parent prop; existing editor context owns the visible tab.
Retain the tab when selecting a root field or nested subform; derive tab ownership from the existing field tree.
Follow a moved field when its parent or tab changes, while preserving inspector selection during same-parent reordering.
Updated both existing canvas hosts; no new route, persisted state, field schema or workflow behavior.

checks.formatting: Prettier applied after checks; whitespace-only changes to the checked implementation/tests.

verified: Renamed tab 2 to 商品资料 using the inspector; added 商品明细 and 商品编号/商品数量 children without switching the visible tab.
Added root 申请编号 while retaining the visible tab; switched to 基本资料 and added 申请人 in that tab.
Native drag from the 日期时间 palette into 商品资料 inserted 交付日期 in that tab.
Saved and cold reloaded; switching to 商品资料 showed the subform and date, with 申请编号 still at the root.
Published V1; entered synthetic 申请人/申请编号, switched tabs, added SKU-TAB quantity 2, switched back with input retained and submitted successfully.

limits: Automated tests cover nested selection and movement between tabs; browser native drag evidence covers new-field insertion, not every existing-field drag or keyboard combination.
No promise to persist transient selected tabs across reload; stored field ownership and published layout are retained.
Backend build only; server explicitly does not support tab fields. Native DB/API execution, local/server migration and complete G09/R5/R6 parity remain unfinished.
This is a bounded designer repair and source inspection, not a comprehensive architecture, security or production-load audit.
